translationNote: English translation of the Czech journal checked on 2026-10-10. This is not a new source verification. IDs, source URLs, factual dates, quantities and uncertainty are preserved.

welcome.title: A guide to life in Strahov
welcome.summary: From your first visit to your own student project.
paragraphs: Choose a chapter, search by topic or bookmark an important page. Entries connect real information with locations on the game map. For indoor spaces, the marker identifies the building, not surveyed doors.

Your nickname in this game is neither SH membership nor an accommodation account. Make reservations, payments and maintenance reports through the official websites. The journal also works in solo exploration.

strahov-history.title: Strahov: changing rooms, halls and a student town
strahov-history.summary: The story of the campus between the stadium and Petřín.
paragraphs: The main campus was built in 1964–1965. Its history is linked to mass gymnastics displays; the long corridors and shared facilities still recall its original purpose.

Block 1 serves administrative functions. Alongside accommodation, Strahov includes a dining hall, sports, student clubs and projects. The proposed redevelopment is a future plan; its designs are not presented here as the current state.

sh-history.title: Silicon Hill: from Doom to a community
sh-history.summary: A student initiative grew alongside the computer network.
paragraphs: In 1993, students in Block 8 connected computers to play Doom. Local networks gradually linked the halls; in 1998, Silicon Hill became part of the CTU Student Union.

In 2005, the networking club merged with Strahov Student Self-Government. In 2007 it acquired the former laundry for today's training centre. Volunteers now bring together technology, culture, sport and representation of residents.

block-representative.title: Block representative
block-representative.summary: A voice for residents of a particular hall on the board.
paragraphs: Block representatives are elected members of the SH board. They bring their hall's concerns and proposals into club decisions. If you want to improve a shared room or discuss a matter in the halls, start with your block representative.
For a technical fault, also contact the accommodation administration through the maintenance log. The student representative and accommodation manager have different roles.

club-representative.title: Club-wide representatives and the board
club-representative.summary: Decisions that go beyond a single hall.
paragraphs: The board consists of ten block representatives, four club-wide representatives and the chair. Club-wide representatives represent all SH members. Together they decide major matters, the club's direction and oversight of adopted decisions.
Elected members serve terms of no more than two years. Current election requirements and dates are in the statutes and election announcements; a game avatar does not grant voting rights.

chair-and-team.title: Chair, deputy chair and central team
chair-and-team.summary: Who coordinates the club and its different areas.
paragraphs: The board elects the chair, who represents the club, leads its operation and prepares the budget. The deputy chair and central managers help with specific areas such as networking, projects, sport and finance.

When checked on 10 October 2026, the official contact page listed Ondřej Slavík as chair and Tomáš Bauer as deputy chair. A post dated 20 September 2026 announced a search for the next chair. Open the current directory before making contact.

office.title: SH office
office.summary: The club's practical base in the administration block.
paragraphs: The club office is in Block 1, on the first floor, door 40 at the right-hand end of the corridor. It handles club administration; check opening hours through the official contact page.
The general contact is kancelar@siliconhill.cz and +420 724 782 500. The journal does not contact anyone automatically.

sh-budget.title: Where SH's money goes
sh-budget.summary: Approved 2026 plan v1.2, not a live account balance.
paragraphs: The board approved the basic 2026 budget v1.2 in resolution 2025-0074. It distinguishes income, financing from earlier funds, expenditure and reserves; the balanced total is not the same as annual income.

Planned income is CZK 6,970,700; income plus financing totals CZK 10,408,989. The projects chapter is CZK 2,681,350 and block representative funds are CZK 250,000. These are the published approved baseline figures; later amendments and actual spending must be checked in official documents.

spending.title: Idea → budget → purchase
spending.summary: How REF and responsibility for spending work.
paragraphs: A REF is an item in the club budget. The authorised spender describes its purpose and costs, obtains approval and only then makes the purchase. Receipts must meet club requirements and spending must stay within the approved amount.

Discuss your idea first with a project leader, block representative or the office. Confirm current limits and deadlines in the valid rules; older dates in guides are not automatically this year's deadlines.

student-union.title: CTU Student Union
student-union.summary: A shared framework for hall and interest clubs.
paragraphs: The first council of the CTU Student Union was formed on 11 February 1998. Silicon Hill became its first club in June of that year. The union connects club activities across CTU.

Its bodies include the Student Parliament, Central Team, Council of Student Self-Governments and Audit Committee. When checked on 10 October 2026, official contacts listed Karel D. Kopecký as president; the general contact is centrala@su.cvut.cz.

suz.title: SÚZ ČVUT
suz.summary: Administration of halls, dining facilities and accommodation services.
paragraphs: The Service Facilities Administration is part of CTU. It runs accommodation and catering services; the SH student club and SÚZ have different responsibilities, although both contribute to life in the halls.

When checked on 10 October 2026, the CTU website and staff directory listed Bc. Michal Vodička as director. SÚZ is based at Vaníčkova 315/7. General enquiries: suz-dotazy@cvut.cz; Strahov central reception: +420 234 678 111.

suz-history.title: The halls through time
suz-history.summary: Changes to particular buildings illustrate the administration's history.
paragraphs: Masaryk Hall reopened to students after refurbishment on 8 September 1999. In Strahov, the refurbished B4 officially opened on 20 June 2024. A new central laundry followed in 2025.

SÚZ operates the buildings while student organisations develop their own activities inside them. The training centre lease shows a concrete collaboration between SÚZ and the Student Union. These milestones are not the founding date of SÚZ itself.

it-services.title: SH network and IT services
it-services.summary: From Wi-Fi to student servers and personal projects.
paragraphs: The SH IT directory covers the network, Wi-Fi, servers, Git, Nextcloud, VPN and other tools. Student technical teams are responsible for individual services.

For network problems, follow the current guide and contact your block administrator. Water or lighting faults belong in the SÚZ maintenance log instead. Your game nickname is not a real network account.

housekeepers.title: Accommodation managers and hall administration
housekeepers.summary: Take accommodation matters to your hall's administration.
paragraphs: Accommodation managers are SÚZ contacts for the operation of individual halls. The official directory lists separate contacts for B2–B10 and a shared contact for B11+12. Office hours may change.

B6: kolej-strahov06@cvut.cz, +420 234 678 226. Find other halls in the official directory linked below. The student block representative represents club members; they do not replace the accommodation manager or technical administration.

defects.title: Report a fault
defects.summary: Enter a report in the SÚZ maintenance log.
paragraphs: SÚZ records broken lights, leaking toilets and shower faults in its maintenance log. Use your real ISKAM accommodation account; the game does not collect accommodation credentials.
steps: Open the official SÚZ student account (ISKAM).
In your accommodation account, choose Ubytování → Kniha závad (Accommodation → Maintenance log).
Give the specific block, room and problem description; check the available form and submit directly in ISKAM.
For an urgent operational issue, also contact reception or hall administration.

laundry.title: Laundry: Student Laundry in B4
laundry.summary: The current system replaced the old block laundries.
paragraphs: The new Student Laundry in B4 opened on 1 April 2025. SÚZ lists daily hours of 06:00–22:00 and payment through the Vyprano app. The April 2025 promotional price is not a current price list.

From 1 May 2025, the old block laundries stopped being used for regular washing. They remain only for special purposes set by SÚZ. Older instructions about borrowing a washing machine in individual halls should therefore not be treated as the current procedure.
steps: Check that your chip card is registered in ISKAM. Non-CTU students should arrange registration with their accommodation manager or central reception.
Before visiting, open the current SÚZ information and Vyprano app instructions.
Choose a machine, pay and follow the instructions on site. Check the current price, not a historical promotion.

b6-guide.title: Block 6: above reception and in the basement
b6-guide.summary: The plan helps you find your way; arrange reservations with the manager.
paragraphs: The B6 wiki includes an orientation plan and a list of shared rooms. The common room is between the fourth and fifth floors above reception. To book it, use the current instructions and reservation system on the block page.
The game interior is based on an orientation plan. It is not a surveyed plan of specific rooms. Labels on older images, such as Photo Studio, may not match the current organisational situation.

get-involved.title: Get involved in a project
get-involved.summary: Bring an idea or help something that is already running.
paragraphs: You do not need to lead an entire project right away. Contact its team and arrange a first visit or a small task. If you have an idea for a new project, contact the project manager; the club's HR team can also help you find your way.
Listed as open in the project directory does not guarantee that someone is at the door right now. Always confirm visits, access, membership and reservations directly with the relevant service.

printing.title: SH 3D printing
printing.summary: Print a component and learn to prepare your own model.
paragraphs: The project offers 3D printing and training. It shares the southern basement of B9 with the makers. Arrange printing and membership conditions with the manager beforehand; the printers are not an open self-service facility.

avc.title: AVC.SH
avc.summary: Sound, video and technology for student events.
paragraphs: The audiovisual centre provides technical support and event recordings. It is based in the training centre. Details of collaboration and current equipment are on the project's website.

foosball.title: SH foosball
foosball.summary: Table football practice and social games.
paragraphs: The project manages training facilities in B8. The current central directory places them on the landing between floors 4 and 5 above reception; the older detail page uses different numbering. Confirm the exact location and access with the manager.

darkroom.title: Darkroom
darkroom.summary: Film photography, developing and a darkroom.
paragraphs: The darkroom on the southern side of B10's third floor provides equipment and knowledge for film photography. Arrange your first visit with the team, who explain operation and safe use of photographic chemicals. Since July 2026 they also handle access to the former Photo Studio.

gamedev.title: GameDev
paragraphs: GameDev is in the official list of open projects. The directory lists MSIT in the training centre. Find out about specific meetings and getting involved through the project manager or the current project directory.

music.title: SH music rooms
paragraphs: The music rooms are in the northern basements of B4, B9 and B10. The project website lists conditions for music membership and card access. Arrange a first visit and use of equipment with the team; check any current contribution on the website.

macgyver.title: MacGyver – SH makers
macgyver.summary: An electromechanical workshop where you try things yourself.
paragraphs: The workshop is in B9's southern basement, room s127, known as Mučírna. It is not a repair service where you simply leave an item: the team helps people create and learn. Check current opening hours before visiting.

table-tennis.title: SH table tennis league
table-tennis.summary: Tournaments, rankings and meeting other players.
paragraphs: The league organises a student table tennis competition. Check the website for the venue and date of each tournament; the central directory does not give a single permanent project room, so the map does not invent a doorway.

sherna.title: SHerna
sherna.summary: Consoles and shared gaming in B4 and B6.
paragraphs: SHerna rooms are above reception in B4 and B6, between the third and fourth floors. Reservations and access requirements are on the project's website. Virtual reality requires training; check the status of individual rooms beforehand.

show.title: SHOW · Silicon Hill Open Wednesday
show.summary: A student festival in the central campus space.
paragraphs: SHOW organises a festival on the central courtyard between the halls. It is an opportunity to get involved in production, technology or organisation. Find the specific edition and dates on the festival website; demo events in the game are not its real programme.

dance.title: Dancing in Strahov
paragraphs: Dance activities use the training centre. Confirm current courses, registration and capacity with the project; visiting the place in the game does not enrol anyone in a real course.

bees.title: Bees in Strahov
bees.summary: Caring for bee colonies by the walls.
paragraphs: The project cares for an apiary in a quiet place by the walls beside B11. If you want to help or learn more, contact the team first. The map point marks the area around B11; individual hives have not been surveyed.

gardens.title: Gardens
gardens.summary: A community garden behind the training centre.
paragraphs: Gardeners grow plants, compost and develop the garden behind the training centre together. Arrange your first visit and anything you would like to bring with the team. You can join with little experience.

retired-projects.title: Projects that have ended
retired-projects.summary: Old labels on a plan do not mean a service is still operating.
paragraphs: According to the directory, Photo Studio SH closed on 1 July 2026; the Darkroom now handles access to its room. Modelland (2011–2026), Kompanie MonSilica (2020–2024) and the Art Group (2009–2018) are retired projects.
The archive preserves their place in history. These entries are not presented as currently open services or real events happening today.

training-center.title: Training centre
training-center.summary: A former laundry turned into a place for learning.
paragraphs: SH uses the training centre at Olympijská 1912/2 for lectures, courses and other activities. Discuss the rooms and current booking options with the manager; club activities have priority.
AVC is also based here and other project activities take place here. The map shows the building, not real-time room availability.

sports.title: Silicon Gym, bouldering and sports grounds
sports.summary: Sports facilities have different managers and rules.
paragraphs: Silicon Gym is in B2's basement, with an outdoor entrance on the side facing B3. B2 also has a bouldering wall. Use the official sports pages for access and current operation.
SÚZ manages the halls' outdoor sports grounds. A game reward or virtual presence is not a reservation at a real sports facility.

grill.title: Barbecue centre
grill.summary: A place to meet beside B11, behind the transformer station.
paragraphs: The enclosed area has seating, grills and basic facilities. The site and a mobile grill can be booked according to the options in the official system. Reservations must be confirmed by the manager.
The map point uses the location published directly on the wiki. Check actual availability, handover and cleaning rules before an event.

clubroom-sh.title: SH common room in B7
clubroom-sh.summary: A meeting place for club bodies, sections and projects.
paragraphs: The SH common room is at the southern end of B7's basement corridor. It is mainly used for club meetings. Arrange reservations and access with the chair under the current rules.
The SH common room in B7 and the B6 block common room are two different places.
